meta.name: dependency-graph-manager
meta.description: Updates the Global Dependency Graph (`docs/dependency-graph.md`) by scanning all feature stories for dependency metadata. Use this skill at the end of feature planning or whenever new stories are added/modified to keep the project-wide build order visualization up to date.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描特性故事,自动刷新全局依赖图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在特性依赖基础上安排开发顺序
copy.tagline_en: Scan feature stories and keep the global dependency graph up to date
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to sequence development based on feature dependencies

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扫描项目里的功能故事文件，提取每个故事的编号、状态和依赖关系，然后生成一张 Mermaid 依赖图和一份 graph.yaml 数据文件，并更新到 docs/dependency-graph/ 目录，让人能看图了解构建顺序。
howto.when: 在功能规划结束，或新增/修改了故事文件后，要求更新依赖图时触发。

say.note: Claude 会扫描 stories 并重写依赖图文档。

howto.what_en: Installing this skill lets Claude scan feature story files under docs/features/, extract their IDs, status, and dependency metadata, then generate a Mermaid diagram and graph.yaml, updating them in docs/dependency-graph/ to visualize the project build order.
howto.when_en: Triggered at the end of feature planning or whenever new stories are added/modified, when you ask to update the dependency graph.

say_en.note: Claude scans stories and rewrites the graph docs.
